Probe an address and report what answered.

Deliberately a real request, not a re-run of the readiness list: an operator
typing an address wants to know whether *that* address works, before saving
it. It also catches the classic mistake — an address that points back at
this node — which otherwise only surfaces later as a pair that will not arm.
